name: WildSpeech-Bench
description: A benchmark of real-world wild/noisy speech recordings designed to evaluate robustness of speech models under diverse acoustic conditions. It measures automatic speech recognition performance (and optionally related tasks) on unconstrained, in-the-wild audio with varying noise, reverberation, and recording devices. The set is intended to benchmark ASR systems' generalization to real noisy environments.
reputation: A niche but useful resource for robustness evaluation in ASR research with modest adoption in the speech community.
